name: Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares - § 100 - Am 38
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 55e. Emphasises that digital justice tools relying on AI must comply with fundamental rights, including requirements for annual bias audits, technical transparency, and meaningful human oversight and contestability, in line with the AI Act1a; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 June 2024 laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence and amending Regulations (EC) No 300/2008, (EU) No 167/2013, (EU) No 168/2013, (EU) 2018/858, (EU) 2018/1139 and (EU) 2019/2144 and Directives 2014/90/EU, (EU) 2016/797 and (EU) 2020/1828 (Artificial Intelligence Act) (OJ L, 2024/1689, 12.7.2024, ELI:[http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/1689/oj](http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/1689/oj)).
